pages.title: Absolute Notes III
pages.text: The last volume of all: the axiom key, absolute infinity, pocket universes, axiom schemas, epsilon-naught and an inaccessible cardinal. It ends where mathematics itself ends. I read it once, closed it, and went for a long walk.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)For the closing volume I needed the largest objects I had ever handled - an inaccessible cardinal, epsilon-naught, absolute infinity - with an axiom key and an axiom schema to frame them. Pressed together with a pocket universe, they finished the record.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Omnilex.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Dossier.
